operations.title: Separated boundary support prevents cancellation but not annihilation
operations.statement: If im(Omega_r S_q) intersects im(S_r Omega_q) trivially, a zero composite defect forces both transported defects to vanish. Recovering Omega_r needs detection by S_q (surjectivity suffices); recovering Omega_q needs S_r injective on im Omega_q.

operations.title: Kernel annihilation survives separated-support testing
operations.procedure: Take S_q identity, S_r=[1 0], Omega_r=0, and im Omega_q spanned by (0,1).
operations.outcome: The composite defect vanishes and transported supports are separated, while Omega_q remains nonzero.
operations.falsifier: This falsifies terminal stage certification from support separation alone.
